relationships.subject: dorsal horn CGRP interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: chemogenetic activation of the neurons produced a mechanical hypersensitivity in response to von Frey stimulation, whereas their caspase-mediated ablation led to mechanical hyposensitivity

relationships.subject: Aβ primary afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: synchronous, electrical non-nociceptive Aβ primary afferent stimulation of dorsal roots depolarized the CGRP interneurons, consistent with their receipt of a VGLUT1 innervation

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: In fact six days after inducing the spared nerve injury (SNI) model of neuropathic pain, we found that brushing the ipsilateral paw evoked Fos expression in 50% (53/110 tdTomato cells) of the dorsal horn CGRP interneurons

key_findings: Identified a population of CGRP-expressing excitatory (Lmx1b+, RORα+) interneurons in lamina III of dorsal horn receiving monosynaptic Aβ input and under tonic inhibitory control.

Chemogenetic activation caused mechanical hypersensitivity and ablation caused hyposensitivity, but ablation did not alter SNI-induced mechanical allodynia; after SNI, brush induced Fos in these neurons.
